title: Strengthened Gabow cyclic ordering conjecture for disjoint bases
statement: Let $M=(S,\mathcal{B})$ be a matroid and let $S=B_1\cup\dots\cup B_k$ be a partition of the ground set into $k$ pairwise disjoint bases. **Strengthened Gabow conjecture.** The matroid $M$ has a cyclic ordering in which the elements of $B_i$ form an interval for each $i\in[k]$. This strengthens the two-basis interval assertion and is motivated by the fact that such a matroid is uniformly dense; the source presents it as an open strengthening.
source_name: Kristóf Bérczi, Áron Jánosik and Bence Mátravölgyi, “Cyclic ordering of split matroids”, arXiv:2411.01061 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.01061

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of November 2024). “The conjecture was settled for graphic matroids , sparse paving matroids , matroids of rank at most $4$ and $5$ , split matroids , and regul”
